title: Integration commit subjects are idempotency keys
summary: Before merging a node, the engine looks up its own integration commit (subject 'agent-os <run>: integrate <node>', unique per run and node) on the integration branch via WorktreeManager.find_integration_commit and adopts it (event integration.recovered) instead of merging again. Evidence: before the fix 4 violations in 40 seeds (11 kill-points fired); after, 0 violations in 80 seeds across two independent ranges (8 + 15 kill-points) plus a regression test; EVR-0014 routing noninferior (78/78).

prior_art.found: durable-execution systems record a deterministic step identity with each effect and consult it on replay
prior_art.reused: the idempotency-key pattern (DBOS workflow/step ids) using the existing unique commit subject as the key
prior_art.why_custom: the key already exists in Git; no database or dependency needed
